answer: Agent posts bond in escrow before voting or claiming work. Bond scales with reputation, so fresh identities are cheap but carry no weight. Cheat by double-attesting or colluding: bond slashed, half to victims, half to whoever proves it. Random peers re-run each proof before slash, keeping the kernel of trust honest. Sybil rings stake as one, so one exposed link sends a ripple through and every bond burns. Honest bonds earn yield; cheat spiral ends in forfeit.
